base: Use case: style-transfer and precise-object-edit. Edit target: first supplied image, a 512x1024 character animation sprite atlas. Second image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: borrow crisp intentional pixel clusters, dark clean outlines, limited palette highlights and coherent hair shading; DO NOT copy its character, maid outfit, pose or mop. Repair and redraw the target's existing character, preserving recognizable hair color, outfit palette and accessories. Final image MUST be exactly 512 pixels wide by 1024 pixels high, same resolution as target. Strict TWO columns by FOUR rows, eight 256x256 cells with no labels, dividers, borders or gutters. Cell centers x=128 and 384, y=128,384,640,896. Each complete figure fits inside its own cell, including entire hair, ears, accessories, hands and feet with minimum 12px margin. Constant character scale, facing direction and body anchor between frames: local foot baseline y=240, local body center x=128. No clipping, missing skull, holes in hair, distorted eyes, broken hands, duplicate limbs. True crisp pixel art at this resolution, deliberate square pixels and hard edges, no blur or smooth painting. BACKGROUND MUST BE FULLY OPAQUE solid warm gray #A09895 over the whole image, no alpha/transparency, no checkerboard, no shadow. Top row IDLE: relaxed standing, frame A eyes open, frame B gentle blink and minimal breathing, same feet. Second row WALK: two readable opposite contact poses with alternating front leg and counter-swinging arms, same center and scale; natural two-frame walking-in-place loop. Third row WORK: the same task and same prop present in BOTH frames, hands alternate a small functional movement, never a prop appearing/disappearing. Fourth row THINK: same hand at chin and other arm supporting elbow, tiny head tilt/eye change, minimal two-frame pondering loop. Do not use whole-body scaling or unrelated poses for animation. Every row reads as one consistent two-frame action. Character-specific identity and work action:

characters.walkRepair: Precise sprite animation repair. Preserve this entire 2-column 4-row pixel-art sprite atlas, identity, hair, clothing, other six cells, opaque gray backdrop and 1:2 canvas aspect. EDIT ONLY WALKING ROW 2, RIGHT COLUMN CELL. Current two walk frames incorrectly show same leg forward. In the right walking cell draw the OPPOSITE contact pose from the left walking cell: if left cell has screen-left foot in front and low with visible shoe toe, right cell MUST have screen-RIGHT foot in front and low with visible shoe toe, and screen-LEFT foot behind and raised. Reverse BOTH leg positions and BOTH arm swings. Clear visible leg swap is ESSENTIAL for two-frame walking loop. DO NOT mirror the character's head, hairstyle, bow, bag or clothing asymmetries: preserve face and body orientation. Head remains same x,y as left walk frame relative to cell, same size and intact silhouette. Keep both feet and head fully within cell with 12px equivalent margin. Other rows remain as supplied, same idle blink, work with same props in both frames, chin-rest thinking. Keep clean hard pixel edges. No labels, no extra frames, no transparency. Output 512x1024 if possible.
